about: HR's assistant (11 Nov 2026): a login that sees only HR's Monthly Calendar, Odometer Check, Trips & Routes, Monthly Expenses and Range Summary, and the Item Requests read-only. Ticked by hand on the User in Desk, like Is HR Manager. Create this field BEFORE installing the item_request.py that reads it: a Server Script asking for a column the site lacks fails for everyone. The login also needs the same ERPNext roles as the HR Manager login, so it can read what those pages show.
